_comment: Shared corpus for the crisis lexicon. The backend (backend/domain/safety/classify.py) and the client mirror (frontend/src/voice/safety/crisisLexicon.ts) are both asserted against this file, which is what keeps them from drifting. Phrasing is written the way ASR actually emits it: lowercase, unpunctuated, apostrophes dropped, words split unpredictably. This is keyword matching, not clinical screening.
